class.name: om6dof_controllers/TrajectoryController
class.description: Follows a joint trajectory on the OM6DOF arm. Accepts trajectories over a FollowJointTrajectory action or a plain topic, samples them with cubic interpolation, and writes either position commands or effort commands (PD plus gravity feed-forward).

class.name: om6dof_controllers/GravityCompensationController
class.description: Writes the joint efforts that cancel gravity, computed from the robot description with KDL, plus an optional Coulomb/viscous friction feed-forward. Holds no position setpoint of its own, so the arm becomes free to lead by hand.

class.name: om6dof_controllers/LeaderArmController
class.description: Lead-by-hand leader arm. Claims both position and effort: it freezes the position setpoint while the arm is still so it holds itself up, tracks the measured position while a person moves it so nothing springs back, and caps the current from the gravity model so it feels light. Replaces arm_controller while active.

class.name: om6dof_controllers/SpringActuatorController
class.description: Turns each joint into a virtual spring-damper about a rest position, optionally on top of gravity compensation. The rest position can be captured on activation or streamed in over a topic.
